scope.zoom: 10–500–10%, each step, manual values, clamping, reset
scope.scroll: Cold and first-traversal native animation frames, Home/End, reading position; five-pass warm measurements are separate
scope.panes: TOC/navigator hide/show, full width, list/tree, expand/collapse
scope.fullscreen: Native entry, controls inside fullscreen, exit and viewport restoration
scope.harness: Unchanged before/after; timer-mode CI is excluded
scope.baselineMac: Preserved completed 37-fixture run from the preceding task
scope.baselineWindows: New complete 37-fixture run immediately before source synchronization

methodology.frames: Five passes of 30 native animation frame intervals, 120 CSS pixel steps. Warm aggregate pools passes 2–5 across all 37 fixtures. First pass preserved separately. Values rounded to 0.001 ms.
methodology.controls: Control durations include native IPC and two animation frames; fullscreen includes OS transitions. Separate complete-control and five-pass scroll runs.
methodology.memory: macOS process-tree physical footprint; Windows process-tree private bytes. Different definitions. Includes app and browser processes; system browser runtime excluded from distribution size.
methodology.comparison: Same-machine before/after only; Windows RDP affects display cadence. No competitor benchmark. Ready callback is not completion of all diagrams.
